tutorial-dungeon-nav-city-mode-body: Your squad is assembled. Open City Mode from the terminal home screen to head out.
tutorial-onboarding-claim-all-body: Supply contents confirmed. Execute Claim All.
tutorial-onboarding-claim-row-body: Starter supplies located. Open the package to verify its contents.
tutorial-onboarding-open-apps-menu-body: Open the app menu in the corner. The Inbox entry is marked.
tutorial-onboarding-open-inbox-body: Open the Inbox. Your starter supply package is awaiting collection.
tutorial-skip-confirm-line-1: DAEMON will mark onboarding calibration as skipped after termination.
tutorial-skip-confirm-line-2: This decision cannot be reversed, and the tutorial will not start automatically again.
tutorial-training-target-pending: Target location is not established. Maintain the current screen.
tutorial-training-reset-hint: Clear current progress and restart from the first calibration step.
tutorial-wasteland-build-power-body: Open the marked activity slot and construct a Nuclear Power Plant. Other facilities require sufficient capacity to remain operational.
tutorial-wasteland-build-power-tip: A Nuclear Power Plant supplies baseline power without an assigned agent.
tutorial-wasteland-map-body: This depth signal map organizes facilities by depth. Open a slot to inspect or construct its facility.
tutorial-wasteland-nav-terminal-tab-body: Signal Dive calibration is complete. Open the Terminal tab to return to the primary interface.
tutorial-wasteland-nav-agent-workstation: Open the Wasteland Development Terminal. It controls facility operation while you are away.
tutorial-wasteland-review-power-body: Open the power indicator. Verify the capacity supplied by the Nuclear Power Plant against the current load.
tutorial-wasteland-power-confirm-body: Supply and load are balanced. Wasteland facilities can remain operational; core onboarding is ready to close.
tutorial-complete-welcome-body: Operating access is confirmed. You have completed the essential Signal Dive and Wasteland power procedures.
tutorial-complete-next-body: Explore the city, manage your squad, and keep Wasteland facilities operational.
tutorial-complete-signal-body: Your supply package contains 20 Common Decoders. The Standard Channel can now execute two sets of 10 decodes.
tutorial-complete-error: Tutorial status is not synchronized. Keep this panel open and run the action again.
tutorial-sd-battle-result-body: Threat neutralised. Confirm the readout and return to the dive route.
tutorial-sd-daemon-body: DAEMON can calculate a recommended action from the current intent, hand, and energy, then preselect its card and target.
tutorial-sd-daemon-tip: Open the DAEMON mark at the lower right when tactical calculation is required.
tutorial-sd-end-turn-body: Current actions are complete. Execute End Turn to resolve the enemy action.
tutorial-sd-end-turn-tip: Unused cards enter the discard pile when the turn ends.
tutorial-sd-energy-body: Each turn provides 3 energy and 5 cards. Energy is not retained for the next turn.
tutorial-sd-energy-tip: Convert the available energy into effective actions before ending the turn.
tutorial-sd-entry-body: Dive coordinates are locked. Execute Connect to establish the first route.
tutorial-sd-execute-body: Card and target are selected. Execute the card to transmit the command.
tutorial-sd-execute-tip: Selection and execution are separate stages. Recheck the target before execution.
tutorial-sd-finish-body: Basic combat procedure confirmed. Eliminate the remaining threat.
tutorial-sd-intent-body: Read the enemy intent first. It identifies the action scheduled for the enemy's next turn.
tutorial-sd-intent-tip: Intent follows a fixed cycle. Use it as the first input for every threat assessment.
tutorial-sd-reward-body: Combat complete. Select one card for the current dive deck.
tutorial-sd-reward-tip: The dive deck exists only for the current run and is rebuilt on the next descent.
tutorial-sd-route-body: The route is established. Selecting a connected node moves directly to it; entering a combat node starts combat immediately.
tutorial-sd-route-tip: Node types include combat, event, treasure, shop, and rest.
tutorial-sd-run-end-body: Dive log sealed. Return to the Terminal to continue calibration.
tutorial-sd-select-card-body: Select an attack card from your hand. This only preselects the card; it does not execute it.
tutorial-sd-select-enemy-body: Select an enemy card to lock the target. Attack cards require a valid target.
tutorial-sd-shield-body: An enemy attack is scheduled. Execute a defence card to establish shield.
tutorial-sd-shield-tip: Shield resets at the start of each turn and only absorbs damage during the current turn.
